fancymenu_seamless_capture_async.conversion: @WrapOperation of Screenshot.takeScreenshot in SeamlessWorldLoadingHandler.captureFrameIfNeeded (glGetTexImage into a pixel buffer object + fence, a placeholder image for FancyMenu), @ModifyExpressionValue of its read of lastCapturedImage (the finished image replaces the placeholder), @Inject HEAD of saveAndClearCapture (finish a pending capture) and of clearLastCapturedImage (drop it), and a pixel-address getter on NativeImage; stands aside (FancyMenu's own capture) when another mod's injector handler, or its overwrite of a method of the stock capture (by Mojang name on NeoForge), is merged into Screenshot or NativeImage, read once on the first capture; helper bons.furious.patch.fancymenu_capture_c49.SeamlessCapture
fancymenu_seamless_capture_async.license: FancyMenu's licence (DSMSL) allows none of its code: injectors only; the GL read, the copy, the alpha fill and the flip call are our own code or Minecraft's public NativeImage methods
